working_title: Counterfactual Response Envelope for Team Adversarial Decision-making
primary_intervention: set-valued action-conditioned minimax-regret selection versus capacity-matched posterior-mean response selection
excluded_claims: generic minimax or robust RL novelty
generic PSRO or population diversity novelty
DRTP or PLR style training exposure reweighting
stop_if: the method reduces to an opponent embedding plus conservative head
the strict counterexample requires privileged opponent labels
posterior-mean and response-envelope decisions cannot be separated under matched information
a direct prior work already contains the same action-conditioned version-space regret object

gate_results.blocking_neighbor: Beyond Bayesian Nash: Learning Minimax-Regret Equilibria for Adversarial Team Games under Asymmetric Information (arXiv:2607.09993)
